intro.sr: Zaposleni ima svoj poseban deo naloga za rad sa sopstvenim terminima - potvrđivanje, završavanje i pregled zarađene provizije - potpuno odvojeno od admin panela.
intro.en: An employee has their own dedicated account area for their appointments - confirming, completing, and reviewing earned commission - entirely separate from the admin panel.

prijava-zaposlenog.sr: Zaposleni se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
prijava-zaposlenog.en: The employee logs into their account.

pregled-mojih-termina.sr: U delu „Moji termini” zaposleni vidi samo termine koji su njemu dodeljeni.
pregled-mojih-termina.en: In the "My appointments" section, the employee sees only appointments assigned to them.

otvaranje-detalja-termina.sr: Klikom na termin otvaraju se detalji, sa opcijama za potvrdu i završavanje.
otvaranje-detalja-termina.en: Clicking the appointment opens its details, with options to confirm and complete it.

potvrda-termina.sr: Zaposleni potvrđuje termin - klijent sada ima siguran, potvrđen termin.
potvrda-termina.en: The employee confirms the appointment - the customer now has a firm, confirmed slot.

zavrsavanje-termina.sr: Nakon što je usluga pružena, zaposleni ga označava kao završen - ovo je i trenutak kada se obračunava njegova provizija.
zavrsavanje-termina.en: Once the service has been delivered, the employee marks it completed - this is also when their commission gets recorded.

pregled-provizije.sr: U delu „Provizije” zaposleni odmah vidi zarađeni procenat za ovaj termin.
pregled-provizije.en: In the "Commissions" section, the employee immediately sees the earned percentage for this appointment.
